expectations.text: Output contains all four depth levels (Level 1 through Level 4, or equivalent emoji/label markers)
expectations.evidence: All four levels present with emoji headers: 🧒 Level 1, 🎒 Level 2, 🎓 Level 3, 🔬 Level 4

expectations.text: A TL;DR or one-sentence summary appears near the top, before the level sections
expectations.evidence: **TL;DR:** Public key cryptography lets two strangers communicate secretly — or prove their identity — without ever having to share a secret in advance...

expectations.text: Level 1 section uses no unexplained technical terms — suitable for a 10-year-old
expectations.evidence: Level 1 uses the magic padlock analogy exclusively. 'Public key' and 'private key' are introduced with the padlock metaphor, not as technical terms.

expectations.text: The response ends with an invitation to go deeper or explore a related concept
expectations.evidence: Ends with: '*Want me to go deeper on any of these levels? I can dive further into lattice cryptography and the post-quantum transition, walk through an RSA key exchange step by step...*'

expectations.text: At least one diagram, ASCII visual, Mermaid block, or structured illustration is included
expectations.evidence: Multiple diagrams: ASCII flow for encryption/signing in Level 2, Diffie-Hellman key exchange walkthrough with math in Level 3, certificate chain diagram, elliptic curve point addition diagram.
